gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 Founders Edition, 32 GB
cooler: Alphacool ES RTX 6000 Pro Workstation/RTX 5090 Founders Edition
scope: Published envelopes and port datums from the Alphacool dimensioned assembly drawing; NVIDIA dimensions refer only to the removed stock cooler. PCB sub-board outlines, thickness, stack registration, small hardware, connector location/angle and bracket width/profile are visual inferences from the manual and drawing, not supplier CAD. PCB is right of the main block when looking into the ports. Rounded top notch and carbon/chrome surfaces are schematic. Main PCB is a near-square 108 x 110 mm visual envelope, estimated from TechPowerUp front/back teardown photographs and fitted within the Alphacool envelope; no published bare-PCB dimensional drawing was found.

power_housing_reference.scope: Published cable housing envelope, representative compatible connector; exact NVIDIA header vendor and selected PSU cable are unconfirmed. Latch details, insertion, header, insulated wire diameters and routing are illustrative.

power_header_reference.scope: Separate board-side male header drawing. Render uses shroud, signal pod and latch ramp; hidden contacts and solder tails omitted. Installed board position remains inferred; actual NVIDIA supplier is not established.
